model.name: WavePINNv14b
model._note: Architecture identical to v12 — v14 changes supervision, model selection and loss only, so the comparison isolates those.

data._note_strict_iq: A configured PRF step that cannot be honoured now drops the sample at construction instead of silently reverting to the native step. 38/154 500Hz train samples lack raw IQ on disk and were previously training at dt_in=24ms instead of 2ms with nothing in the logs to say so.
data._note_augmentation: v12/v13 declared steps [2,4,5,6,8,10,12] but raw IQ for every 5/10/20kHz sample is absent in this environment, so _load_augmented_iq always failed and fell back to native step 12. The declared augmentation never happened. Declaring [12] makes the real behaviour explicit; with strict_iq on, anything else would now be a hard error rather than a silent lie.

frequency_step_overrides._note: 500Hz still forced to step=1 (dt=2ms, consecutive frames) — the deployment scenario.

loss._note_frame_mask: C1: supervise interpolated targets only at frames where ground truth genuinely exists. For 500Hz samples the dense target is a linear interpolation of the same 5 input frames, so 44 of 49 target frames carried no information and actively rewarded piecewise-linear output.
loss._note_spectral: C2: log-magnitude L1 between predicted and ground-truth temporal spectra, frequency-weighted 1->2 across 250-1500 Hz, applied ONLY to samples with fully genuine dense ground truth. Targets the measured deficit: v12 reconstructs HF phase well (band coherence 0.73) but carries only ~46% of the true HF energy.

early_stopping._note: v12 selected on val_500hz_l1 = L1 against that same linear interpolation, so checkpoint selection preferred the most interpolation-like model. 5kHz val is native step 12: dt_out == dt_native, genuine dense ground truth, frame for frame.
